body:
Second case in hotsrm: `srm_supplier` (OWD `public_read`). Category managers must edit suppliers they don't own (legacy suppliers imported by an admin, hotsrm#15), so their permission set got `modifyAllRecords: true` with `allowDelete: false`, and they can now delete any supplier, which cascades to its contacts and certificates through `master_detail`. Same need as above: edit all, delete none.

Director seat, summon #49 (session `session_0162wFwDdLFGhaSvDdSnZ9Sx`, account `os-zhuang`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; ledger objectstack-ai/objectstack#12708). Ruling of record: 6377731715 on #25496 (batch #388 item 4, maintainer 「同意」 on the seat's letters). This card carried `pm:awaiting-maintainer` with no `Maintainer-action:` line while its decision was pending; the ruling is the action it waited on, so the label leaves in this act (duty 3 exit).

**What the lane builds (letter A):** the Salesforce semantics stay — `modifyAllRecords` is the write bypass for edit, delete and transfer (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-evaluator.ts:76–83`, `:289`; the spec fold `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts:214` is the same). The schema refuses, at publish and in lint, an object-permission entry that sets `modifyAllRecords: true` beside an explicit `allowDelete: false`: a contradiction the schema accepted and ignored, which is the trap both hotsrm cases fell into. The docs name the existing route for "edit all records, delete none": a `criteria` sharing rule with `accessLevel: 'edit'` to the position on a `public_read` object (`packages/spec/src/security/sharing.zod.ts:35`, `:76`; ADR-0111 D3 removed edit-share delete; the object's effective model `read` is an enforcing posture under D7). Whether a rule's `condition` can select every row is unverified — the dev reads it first and the docs state what they find. Not taken: B (honour `allowDelete: false` under Modify All — rewrites the security fold), a new `editAllRecords` key. Workload S.

Ruling: batch #9 item 1 (#25496) · letter A · maintainer 「#9 同意」 2026-10-24T00:43:45Z

**A** = 维持 Salesforce 语义（Modify All 含编辑 / 删除 / 转移），但在发布时**拒绝** `modifyAllRecords: true` + `allowDelete: false` 的自相矛盾组合（是拒绝，不只是 lint 警告），把今天「声明了却没执行」的静默陷阱变成响亮报错；「能改所有、不能删」用行级规则 / 共享规则表达，不改超级权限的含义（shape 2 `editAllRecords` 不采）。工作量 S。A 是做事，不是「不做」，卡不关。总裁决：#25496 评论 6377842908。

维护者动作已完成：摘 `pm:awaiting-maintainer`，回 `pm:queue`；裁不派。
